root.name: スプラウト・ソーシャル

relations.text: Sprout Socialは、クラウド基盤の大半をAmazon Web Servicesに委託し、プラットフォームと製品をそこで稼働させている
relations.text_en: Sprout Social outsources the majority of its cloud infrastructure to Amazon Web Services, which hosts its platform and products

source.label: Sprout Social 10-K
source.quote: We outsource the majority of our cloud infrastructure to Amazon Web Services, or AWS, which hosts our platform and products.

relations.text: 2020年第3四半期、Sonyは新規顧客ブランドとして加わった
relations.text_en: Sony joined as a new customer brand in the third quarter of 2020

source.label: Sprout Social 8-K Ex.99 の発表
source.quote: • During the third quarter, we had the opportunity to help new customer brands like Electronic Arts, Discover, Taco Bell, The Cleveland Cavaliers, Sony, Nikon, and Purdue University.
source.note: 2020年の発表に基づく記載です。

relations.text: Salesforceとの新しい連携を発表している
relations.text_en: Announced a new integration with Salesforce

source.label: Sprout Social 8-K Ex.99 の発表
source.quote: • Deepened our CRM capabilities and announced new integrations with Microsoft Dynamics 365 and Salesforce that enhance existing integrations with Hubspot and Zendesk.
source.note: 2020年の発表に基づく記載です。

relations.text: Sprout Socialは、FacebookやInstagramなどの主要SNSと戦略的な関係を築いている
relations.text_en: Sprout Social has cultivated strong, strategic relationships with leading social networks including Facebook and Instagram.

source.label: Sprout Social 10-K
source.quote: We have cultivated strong, strategic relationships with leading social networks—including Facebook, Instagram, Threads, X (formerly Twitter), Pinterest, LinkedIn, YouTube, Reddit, Tumblr, Bluesky and TikTok.
source.note: 主要SNSとの関係として名前が挙がっているものです。
source.note_en: Named among Sprout Social's social network relationships.

relations.text: スプラウト・ソーシャルと競合する

source.label: Sprout Social 10-K
source.quote: We primarily face competition from other social media management companies such as Hootsuite, Khoros and Sprinklr, as well as a range of independent point solutions.

note.ja: 公式資料で確認できた関係だけを載せています。投資判断を勧めるものではありません。
note.en: Only relationships confirmed in official materials are shown. Not investment advice.
